page.overview:
What is House of the Dragon?

House of the Dragon Portuguese: A Casa do Dragão Spanish: La Casa del Dragón}} is the second live-action television series of the World of Westeros — part of Game of Thrones.

It is the second installment of the franchise overall. It was ordered by HBO in October 2019. The prequel goes back approximately 200 years to center on the beginning of the end of the once all-powerful dynasty that dominated the Seven Kingdoms of Westeros.
